mapper.select: SELECT PSTING_ID, BBS_TYPE_CD, PSTING_NO, TITLE, SBST, RETV_NUM, SHOW_YN, IMPT_YN, DEL_YN, TO_CHAR(REG_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS REGDATE FROM KOA_TB_BBS WHERE SHOW_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND BBS_TYPE_CD = 'BBSTYP1010' ORDER BY REG_DT DESC LIMIT 3
